originalTitle: Broadcom delivers strong earnings view as CEO touts growth with AI labs
summary: Broadcom gave a disappointing revenue forecast for the current quarter but provided robust earnings guidance for fiscal 2028.
content:
Broadcom shares edged up in extended trading on Wednesday after the chipmaker issued a rosy forecast for the next fiscal year and hinted at growing business with artificial intelligence labs.

Here's how the company did in comparison with LSEG consensus:

For the fiscal fourth quarter, Broadcom said it expects revenue of $34.8 billion, while analysts were expecting $35.03 billion, according to LSEG.

Broadcom's revenue increased 86% during the quarter from $15.95 billion a year ago, according to a statement . Net income more than tripled to $13.09 billion, or $2.68 per share, from $4.14 billion, or 85 cents per share a year earlier.

Broadcom has been one of the major winners of the AI boom, designing custom chips for companies including Google , Meta and OpenAI . The stock has jumped by more than sixfold since the end of 2022, coinciding with the emergence of ChatGPT and other generative AI services, pushing its market cap to about $1.8 trillion.

But the shares have lagged the broader indexes this year. As of Wednesday's close, Broadcom shares had gained about 6% in 2026, while the S&P 500 index is up 12% in the same period.

During the quarter, Broadcom touted the custom Jalapeno chip it developed with OpenAI, while Apple said it would spend more with Broadcom for U.S. chip production.

CEO Hock Tan said on a conference call that Broadcom expects to speed up shipments of Google Ironwood tensor processing units to Anthropic and TPU 8i chips to Google .

He said Broadcom will deliver tens of billions of dollars of processors to Google each year for the next several years.

"Shipments of Jalapeno for OpenAI will continue, and for Meta , we expect production shipments of their custom MTIA accelerator optimized for inference and recommendation at scale," Tan said.

Broadcom is looking for Anthropic to deploy deploy 5 gigawatts of TPU 8i chips in 2027, with line of sight to deliver another 10 gigawatts, Tan said. Tan said OpenAI is getting ready to tape out its second-generation chip, and the lab is putting together plans with Broadcom for a third version.

He said Broadcom is looking at a 1.3 gigawatt deployment of Jalapeno in 2027, with a line of sight of over 5 gigawatts for Jalapeno and the second generation.

For the 2027 fiscal year, Tan said Broadcom is looking to double AI revenue to $115 billion, with plans to double again to $230 billion in fiscal 2028. The company is on target to produce over $30 in earnings per share, he said. The LSEG consensus for fiscal 2028 adjusted earnings per share was $25.86.

"We are empowering two of our most strategic customers, the leading AI labs, to bridge the gap between their current cash flow and the significant upfront investments required for their businesses," said Amie Thuener, Broadcom's finance chief.

Broadcom might provide residual value guarantees that are contingent liabilities to the labs, she said.

"It makes economic sense for Broadcom to invest and enable these guys," Tan said.

Semiconductor revenue more than tripled to $16.7 billion, exceeding the $15.2 billion average estimate, according to StreetAccount. Broadcom said it generated $8.75 billion from infrastructure software, less than the $8.82 billion consensus among analysts polled by StreetAccount.

chineseTitle: 博通首席执行官吹捧 AI 实验室实现增长，盈利前景强劲
chineseSummary: 博通对本季度的收入预测令人失望，但对 2028 财年提供了强劲的盈利指引。
chineseContent:
芯片制造商博通发布了对下一财年的乐观预测，并暗示与人工智能实验室的业务不断增长，该公司股价周三在盘后交易中小幅上涨。

以下是该公司与 LSEG 共识的比较结果：

据 LSEG 称，博通预计第四财季营收为 348 亿美元，而分析师预期为 350.3 亿美元。

根据一份声明，博通本季度的收入比一年前的 159.5 亿美元增长了 86%。净利润从上年同期的 41.4 亿美元（即每股 85 美分）增长两倍多，达到 130.9 亿美元（即每股 2.68 美元）。

博通一直是人工智能热潮的主要赢家之一，为谷歌、Meta 和 OpenAI 等公司设计定制芯片。自 2022 年底以来，随着 ChatGPT 和其他生成式人工智能服务的出现，该股已上涨六倍多，使其市值达到约 1.8 万亿美元。

但今年该股的表现落后于大盘指数。截至周三收盘，博通股价在 2026 年上涨了约 6%，而同期标准普尔 500 指数上涨了 12%。

本季度，博通大力宣传其与 OpenAI 合作开发的定制 Jalapeno 芯片，而苹果则表示将与博通投入更多资金用于美国芯片生产。

首席执行官 Hock Tan 在电话会议上表示，博通预计将加快向 Anthropic 交付 Google Ironwood 张量处理单元以及向 Google 交付 TPU 8i 芯片。

他表示，博通将在未来几年每年向谷歌提供数百亿美元的处理器。

Tan 表示：“OpenAI 的 Jalapeno 出货量将继续，对于 Meta 来说，我们预计其定制 MTIA 加速器的量产出货量将针对大规模推理和推荐进行优化。”

Tan 表示，Broadcom 正在寻求 Anthropic 在 2027 年部署 5 吉瓦的 TPU 8i 芯片，并计划再提供 10 吉瓦的能力。 Tan 表示，OpenAI 正准备流片其第二代芯片，该实验室正在与博通制定第三代芯​​片的计划。

他表示，博通计划在 2027 年部署 Jalapeno 1.3 吉瓦，其中 Jalapeno 和第二代的功率范围将超过 5 吉瓦。

Tan 表示，博通希望在 2027 财年将人工智能收入翻一番，达到 1150 亿美元，并计划在 2028 财年再次翻一番，达到 2300 亿美元。他表示，该公司的目标是每股收益超过 30 美元。伦敦证券交易所集团对 2028 财年调整后每股收益的共识为 25.86 美元。

博通财务主管 Amie Thuener 表示：“我们正在为我们最具战略意义的两个客户（领先的人工智能实验室）提供支持，以弥合他们当前的现金流与其业务所需的大量前期投资之间的差距。”

她说，博通可能会提供残值担保，这些担保是实验室的或有负债。

谭说：“博通投资并支持这些人具有经济意义。”

根据 StreetAccount 的数据，半导体收入增长了两倍多，达到 167 亿美元，超过了 152 亿美元的平均预期。 Broadcom 表示，其基础设施软件收入为 87.5 亿美元，低于 StreetAccount 调查的分析师一致认为的 88.2 亿美元。
